test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

Every piece of furniture in her house is in __apple-pie order__.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"in apple-pie order"** means very **neatly and tidily arranged**. (बहुत साफ-सुथरा और व्यवस्थित) • **Example: **After cleaning the house, everything was in** apple-pie order.** • **Very neatly arranged** refers to something that is organized in a tidy and orderly fashion. (बहुत ही व्यवस्थित रूप से रखा हुआ) • **Example: **All the files on his desk were** very neatly arranged.** Therefore, the correct answer is:** Very neatly arranged**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Painted in light colours** (हल्के रंगों में रंगा हुआ): Refers to something that has been painted using light shades. • **Example:** The walls of her room are **painted in light colours.** • **Kept in a disorganised way** (अव्यवस्थित तरीके से रखा हुआ): Refers to something that is not arranged neatly. • **Example:** His books were **kept in a disorganised way **on the shelf. • **Very delicately arranged** (बहुत ही नाजुक तरीके से रखा हुआ): Refers to something that is arranged with great care and delicacy. • **Example:** The flowers were **very delicately arranged** in the vase. 51:Tbe7, The correct answer is **Option 3)**
